cohort: Singleton pregnancies at a tertiary unit in Brisbane, Australia, including 4733 ART conceptions and 59,277 spontaneous conceptions
finding: While women who conceived using ART had higher rates of operative deliveries, neonatal outcomes were generally similar between the ART and spontaneous conception groups, with the exception of lower odds of neonatal acidosis in the ART group.
mod_finding: Women who conceived using ART were less likely to have a spontaneous vaginal delivery and were more likely to require operative or assisted birth, including elective caesarean, emergency caesarean, or instrumental delivery.
birth_weight: Neonates who were conceived using ART were less likely to be born at term and have lower birth weights.
